text: check out this guy, doing something similar sending Lora packets without a radio - [VIDEO] "This video explores LoRaWAN communication using a microcontroller without a dedicated radio chip. story: Rawdrawandroid – Build Android apps without any Java, in C and Make
text: cnlohr is in his own league, this guy is bordering on genius. Dissatisfied with the state of the vendor SDK for CH32V003 microcontrollers (ultra-cheap RISC-V MCUs), he created his own [1], which is a pleasure to use. He also has a header-only RISC-V emulator that runs Linux (and Doom!) [2], and hacked an ESP32 to emit valid LORA frames with clever use of aliasing [3]. [1] [LINK] [2] [LINK] [3] [VIDEO]

story: Show HN: A high-altitude low-power flight computer for high-altitude balloons
text: In fact, it's so robust that even when your antenna is a piece of wire hanging off a GPIO of a microcontroller with absolutely no dedicated radio hardware, you can still get several km of range. Truly crazy stuff. [VIDEO]
